newsitem.title: USA: Orbital sees revenue growth continuing.
newsitem.headline: Orbital sees revenue growth continuing.

text.p: NEW YORK, Sept 16 (Reuter) Orbital Sciences Corp expects revenue growth to continue at an average rate of about 25 percent per year over the next several years, chief executive David W. Thompson told financial analysts.
Speaking at a company-sponsored meeting Monday, Thompson said he expects the fastest growth to take place in commercial and international demand for Orbital's low-cost space products and services.
He said he also expects steady improvement in operating margins and strong growth in net income, without substantial equity dilution.
He stated that Orbital is committed to maintaining its traditional leadership role in the development of innovative space-related systems.

Thus far in 1996, Thompson said, Orbital has received over $500 million in new orders for its infrastructure systems, bringing total infrastructure backlog, including firm contract orders and options, to $1.9 billion.
